keyword: what did sinners win at the oscars
claims: The 98th Academy Awards were held in 2026.
Ryan Coogler's Sinners won four Oscars from 16 nominations at the 98th Academy Awards.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards for playing Smoke and Stack in Sinners.
Ryan Coogler won Best Original Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards for Sinners.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw won Best Cinematography at the 98th Academy Awards for Sinners.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw is the first woman to win the Oscar for Best Cinematography.
Ludwig Göransson won Best Original Score at the 98th Academy Awards for Sinners.
Sinners is a vampire horror film set in the Jim Crow South
